title: EgoBrain-Mini: egocentric video, 32-channel EEG, wrist/arm IMU and audio during everyday actions (40 adults)
description: EgoBrain-Mini is the BIDS edition of the lightweight egocentric release of EgoBrain. It provides synchronised first-person video, 32-channel EEG, four body-worn IMUs and audio from 40 adults performing 39 everyday seated actions, totalling 1,562 sub-actions and about 63 hours of EEG. The dataset supports research on multimodal human action understanding and brain-behaviour decoding. Raw EEG values, audio and video are unchanged from the original release, and the original files are kept under sourcedata.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an EMOTIV FLEX 2 Gel headset (32 channels, 256 Hz) with CMS/DRL reference sensors on the earlobes. A GoPro mounted on the headset captured egocentric video (854x480, about 30 fps) and audio. Four IMUs were worn on the wrists and upper arms. Seated participants followed a screen prompt, performed the action, then clicked end, and that bracket defines each sub-action. IMU sampling rates differ across participants (about 10 Hz or 200 Hz).
